english.note: Use this for a time later than now, including expressions such as 一年以後.

exampleSentences.english: A year hence, we may have moved house.
exampleSentences.traditional: 一年以後，我哋可能已經搬咗屋。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jat1 nin4 ji5 hau6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 ji5 ging1 bun1 zo2 uk1

english.note: Use this for movement or continuation into the future, as in “from now on” or “later on.”

exampleSentences.english: Going forward, ask me if anything is unclear.
exampleSentences.traditional: 以後有咩唔明就問我啦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ji5 hau6 jau5 me1 m4 ming4 zau6 man6 ngo5 laa1
